comparison.objective: Place setting blocks and stand glazing on them without sill contact; candidate commissions an axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Large fragile-panel handling and coordinated lowering versus small-tool engagement, fine rotation, locking, and iterative testing.
comparison.success_condition: Glass must be supported on correctly located blocks, stable and released, with no sill contact; candidate requires bounded dynamic stops and retained adjustment.
comparison.reason: Fragile panel placement and support sequencing do not duplicate damper tuning.
